gt_flags.translation: How much will I give? How much will I give you? I will give 300 rupees, 400 rupees, 500 rupees.
gt_flags.excerpt: कितने दूँगा मैं? कितने दूँगा मैं आपको? 300 रुपये दूँगा, 400 रुपये दूँगा, 500 रुपये दूँगा.

model_flags.translation: You are showing your body to everyone for 300 rupees, okay?
model_flags.excerpt: तीन सौ रुपए में आप बॉडी दिखा रहे हो सबको ठीक है
model_flags.model_context: The user talks about money and accuses the expert of showing her body on video call. The expert denies and gets angry.
